calls.title: GrowthBook x Capture Higher Ed POC Check-in
calls.summary: The team successfully integrated Snowflake data with Growth Book and initiated a mock data experiment, which ran for 27 minutes with a 50/50 control-test split. Conversion rates showed slight differences between groups, indicating a need for increased data volume to validate results. SDK integration delays were acknowledged, with a deadline of July 31 for completing the PoC. User access issues arose due to personal versus enterprise account confusion, and administrative actions were taken to resolve these. The meeting set a follow-up for July 28 at 11 AM to ensure progress on integrating dynamic personalized data from the development environment.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Snowflake, PoC, SDK integration, Bayesian analysis, Enterprise license
